inventory_saver.config.title: Inventory Saver
inventory_saver.config.enabled.tip: Turns the whole mod on or off. The keybinds do nothing while it is off.
inventory_saver.config.profiles.tip: Use several save profiles per server/world. When off, a single save is used.
inventory_saver.config.profile.tip: Click to switch to the next profile. Save and restore use the active profile.
inventory_saver.config.remember.tip: ON: items go back to a slot with a matching stack size where possible. OFF: only the item type counts and stack sizes are ignored.
inventory_saver.config.separate.tip: ON: stacks of the same item are never merged while sorting (a few more clicks). OFF: faster, but two partial stacks of the same item may get merged.
inventory_saver.config.clicks.tip: How many inventory clicks are sent per tick. 0 = unlimited: everything is sent in a single tick. That is the fastest, but some servers may kick you for sending many clicks at once.
inventory_saver.config.save_now.tip: Closes this menu and saves your current inventory.
inventory_saver.config.restore_now.tip: Closes this menu and restores your saved inventory.
inventory_saver.config.reset.tip: Resets all settings to their defaults.
inventory_saver.config.chat_feedback.tip: Show messages from the mod in the chat.
inventory_saver.config.preview.tip: Show and edit the active profile. Needs a loaded world.
inventory_saver.preview.title: Profile preview: %s
inventory_saver.config.show_preview.tip: Show the active profile as an inventory under the settings. Click a slot to pick up an item, click another slot to move or swap it.
